CustomField.description: Webinar only. When the Arc announcement goes live (UTC). Blank means 8:00 AM in the org's time zone on the event's local date — or the day before when the event starts earlier than that (WebinarAnnouncementService.effectiveAnnounceAt). Must be before Event_Datetime__c; ResourceAdminController.saveResource enforces it.
CustomField.label: Announce at
